lines.text: Techno music; sounds of ki attacks

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Boy, I'm glad you're a Super Saiyan now; I've needed a good training partner!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I don't know Trunks very well, and Vegeta's always so busy... and angry.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I'm not gonna lie; sometimes, I think he doesn't like me.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I mean, who wouldn't like *me*?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Maybe you're just too good.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Na-haw, I'm just Goku! And speaking of Goku, IT'S LUNCH TI--!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Well, guess we don't know what time it is anymore, huh? (Chuckling)

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Don't break Popo's stuff don't break Popo's stuff don't break Popo's stuff don't break Popo's stuff don't break Popo's stuff

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: (Calming down)

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Uh... Dad?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: What're you muttering?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: SIXTH RULE OF POPO'S TRAINING!
♫ "Cha-La Head-Cha-La" ♫
♫ CHA-LA HEAD-CHA-LA ♫
♫ Egao urutora zetto de ♫ (With a smile that’s Ultra-Z)
♫ Kyô mo ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~ ♫ (Even today is ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~)
♫ Sparking! [fading echo] ♫

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Aaah!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Aaaaahh!!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Aaaaaaahhh!!!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaahhhh!!!!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Good Lord, the lungs on that boy!
Trunks continues to yell during his power-up

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: You OK, Trunks? You, uh, doin' good on air--
ZAP

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: dehyeyeyagh!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: And *there's* the twist.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Not to be a broken record, but...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Right, so uh, no worries, your uh... huh, I was gonna say husband, but... well, I was gonna say boyfriend, but--

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Your baby-daddy is still breathing.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Yeah, barely.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Well, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: On the other hand, Trunks is about to fight Cell.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: What?! But he's just a baby!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh-hoh, right... the future one...

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: But he's just a baby!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: OK, ya done?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I'm, I'm so sorry about that!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey man, it's fine.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: My power was rising, I couldn't control it.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: No, it's good, go kill him!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Definitely didn't do that because you spared the Android or anything...

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, obviously.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: ...Right?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You know, if I had a watch, I'd be looking at my wrist reeaaally condescendingly right now...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Krillin, take this. Give it to my father.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: You... sure you won't need it?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: No. This battle was over before it began.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: BAD-ASS!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Also accurate!

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Trunks! Senzu beans heal physical damage! Only therapy will aid emotional trauma.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oh, please. There's not a shrink qualified enough to deal with that hot mess.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And, speaking of shrink...

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Here it comes...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Krillin, go kiss the Prince's booboos. The big boys need to talk.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Fine, whatever. Leave ya to it. Say goodbye, Vegeta!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: (Gurgling)

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I'm going to make you pay in blood for what you did to him!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oh don't lie, boy scout; that *must* have been catharsis by proxy. (Chuckle)

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: He's gonna be waking up for the next five years in a cold *sweat* remembering today!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: (Chuckle)

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I'm not a psychopath like--

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Kind of like you!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Like me??

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Does Gohan know, by the way?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Does he know what?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: That you let him die.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I'm going to power up now.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I'd be disappointed if you didn't!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: (Yelling)

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: That's Trunks?!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Yeah, pretty astonishing, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: It's in*furiating*!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Why? Because the gap keeps widening?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Because he could've: A) Killed Android 18 B) Killed Cell Or C) Killed Vegeta!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Why Vegeta?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Because I deserve SOMETHING today!
Trunks' screaming continues

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: That's right, keep it coming, boy! I want a *real* fight this time!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Don't you worry! I'll show you just how much stronger I am than my father!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Your fathe--?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oh, no, I'm sorry, I wasn't being specific. I'm referring to the *last* time we met.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Of course you wouldn't remember, because you weren't there. (Chuckle)

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I mean, you were, buuuuttt~...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: GET TO THE POINT!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Alright kiddo, tell me: What do you know about time travel?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Less than I should...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Well, how do you suppose I got here?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Well, my Time Machine, obviously.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Ya-huh; and how do you think I *got* said Time Machine?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: ...I don't wanna answer that...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Here's the thing: Multiverse theory's a *bitch*.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Fact is, you - or at least, another you - traveled to the past, saved the world, came back to your future, and finally defeated the Androids.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Congratulations, son. You *won*!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: But wait, then when did you--

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: So you decided to *celebrate*!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Head back to the past, get your hair ruffled, and finally get that *thumbs up* from daddy dearest!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: But you made one. Fatal. Mistake.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You took away what was *mine*!
Flashback Trunks screaming

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Unfortunately, I couldn't fit in your Time Machine, so I had to revert to my larval stage, made the trip to a year before *you* showed up, burrowed underground for four years, and w-well... the rest is history.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Then... you're here...!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Because of *you*!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: But please don't beat yourself up. (Chuckle)

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You're just a child, playing hero... complete with spandex.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: And you are just another mistake that I have to correct.
Powering up
Cell chuckles (again)
Trunks continues to yell (again)

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I'm impressed! Behind all that angst and ridiculous hair, there's a real fighter!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: And behind all that insufferable smarm is a *dead man*!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Trunks... you couldn't fathom the amount of dead men behind me!

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Go, unreasonably buff bird!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Now that might not have done a lot of damage... but *damn* did it feel good!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oh-ho-ho~? Am I sensing an iota of pride?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Guess the apple doesn't fall far if ya *shake* the tree hard enough!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: That snark isn't going to save you while I'm taking you apart.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: If you haven't noticed, I've LITERALLY got you against the wall.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And don't think I don't appreciate the effort.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: By a wide margin, you're packing more of a wallop than daddy ever did!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: However... you will never... *ever*... defeat me with that form.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But why? It's so *strong*!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh yeah! In raw power, it can't be beat.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: But the amount of concentrated energy causes an extreme expansion in mass. The body can't compensate.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And while you'll see a fifty percent power increase, you'll see a seventy-five percent *de*crease in speed AND mobility.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You'd never hit your opponent.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Did-did you...?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: What just...?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Whoop, sorry! Was thinkin' about fightin'.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I'm not sure what just happened.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Silly Gohan! In a lame-man's terms:

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You. Can't. Hit me.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Then what do you call the last five minutes?!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Pity...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Hrrrgh!

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Trunks! Do not worry! He is just playing you.
Perfect Cell hums to himself under Trunks' ineffectual onslaught

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: Correction: He's *been* playing you.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Why?! T-*how*?!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Because you're green.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: ...Wait, you mean...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: No, not like me you idiot; as in, you're a novice, an amateur!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You're surrounded by fighters who have seen more action in a week than you've seen in your ENTIRE LIFE.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Hell, at your age, Goku had defeated an entire army, several demons, and sent a rabbit to the moon!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Did... did you make that last one u--?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And the worst part of it is, that form isn't even new. Watch.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: "Look at me, I'm Trunks! Please love me Daaaad~!"

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: See? Anyone can do it.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: ...That's a terrible impression.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: But not inaccurate!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Why are you still here?!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: For God's sake, I bet even your *father* can do it; he's just not stupid enough to try!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And as we've seen today, that threshold is vast...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Now, how about you come on down, stop using that useless form... and quit wasting everyone's time?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Jeez, I can't tell which is more shattered; your father's body or your spirit...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Just get it over with and kill me already...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Whoa, and spirit it is! Seriously bucko, way to bring down the mood.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Is this all just a game to you?!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: A game? Hardly.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: If this were a game, I'd be having fun... or killing Goku.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Now *that* sounds like a good time.

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: That still doesn't make us friends!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: I'M TRYING, SIXTEEN!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Fine! Go ahead. Fight Goku.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: But when he wins, and when YOU DIE... NOBODY... is going to remember you.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Huh...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Alright; change of plans.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Turn that frown upside-down, boy scout! You're not dying today.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: What in the...? WHY?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Careful, junior; don't want that gift horse to *bite you*!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: You've just given me an idea is all. What *would* I accomplish killing you here?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: No... the whole world needs to see what it's created.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Oh, what the *hell* are you planning now?!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: *My revolution*...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Go take care of your daddy. And make sure to check the news!

lines.speaker: Android 16
lines.text: ...WHAT CHANNEL?!
♫ Closing theme (DBZ intermission) ♫

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, time to see how well Senzu beans do with a broken spine!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: (Groans)
GULP

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: (Gasp) Where am I?! What happened?!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: You *may* have blacked out a little bit...

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: But I'm still alive! H-he must have realized his mistake and run away...

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: (Slight chuckle)

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Dude, c'mon, it's just me.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I... I don't get it... I trained so hard... I reached a new level...! And yet...!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: *Trust* me man, I get you. I mean, my neck's still stiff from earlier.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: (Sniff)... Heh.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I mean, if I had a dime for every time I had my ass kicked, I might not be in crippling debt! (Laughing)

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: (Laughing)

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: But, but if I had gotten a beat down like that, *man*, I would've hung up my gloves, my blue spandex, and my ridiculously pointy hair!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: (Calms down)

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Hnnn!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hahaha, ah-ha, ah-- heeeyy you're not laughing anymore...!
THUMP
DING
Krillin's usual noises

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Could I get a dime for that?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Um... hey... um, if you liked the video, please like and subscribe...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: And uh... uh... check out... the gaming channel? Uh, they're... playing Doom! Um...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Oh! And, uh, the Tenkaichi Ironman Budokai Abridgathon. Where you can be the best abridger ever! Uh, maybe... I guess...?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Sorry... I guess it's just a little weird that I'm not... *dead*...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Oh, uh, they also have a patreon... and... shirts over on sharkrobot.com... huh...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Well, uh... if you don't mind me, I'm gonna go uh... I'm gonna go have a sit.
MLB
